Natural Grocers® will open its second location in Appleton, Wisconsin, on Sept. 30, 2026. Community members are invited to join the celebration with giveaways, savings, free samples, a prize wheel, live local radio and more.


Customers will enjoy unbeatable savings, exciting giveaways, sweepstakes, samples and more


LAKEWOOD, Colo.


, Sept. 16, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / --[Natural Grocers®,](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4774820-1&h=1283093192&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2F&a=Natural+Grocers%C2%AE%2C) the leading family-operated organic and natural grocery retailer in the U.S., announces the opening of a new store in Appleton, Wisconsin, on Wednesday, September 30, 2026. Located at 720 N. Casaloma Drive, the store will serve residents and visitors in Appleton, Fox Crossing, Kaukauna and Neenah, as well as surrounding communities.[The Appleton store](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4774820-1&h=483437338&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Fstore%2Fappleton&a=The+Appleton+store) is Natural Grocers' second location in Wisconsin. Community members are invited to join the celebration with giveaways, savings, free samples, a prize wheel, live local radio and more.


Natural Grocers' good4u® Crew will kick off the festivities at 8:15 a.m. with a $2,500 donation presentation to[Feeding America Eastern Wisconsin,](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4774820-1&h=4083972970&u=https%3A%2F%2Ffeedingamericawi.org%2F&a=Feeding+America%C2%A0Eastern+Wisconsin%2C) its local food bank partner, followed by an official ribbon-cutting ceremony with the Fox City Chamber and store leadership. Doors will open promptly at 8:27 a.m., welcoming customers to a celebratory shopping experience.


"We're thrilled to open our doors in Appleton and welcome the communities of the Fox Valley to Natural Grocers," said Raquel Isely, vice president of marketing at Natural Grocers. "This location allows us to better serve individuals and families seeking affordable organic groceries, free nutrition education and high-quality products that meet our rigorous standards. Following the opening of our Lake Geneva store earlier this year, we're grateful for the opportunity to continue growing in Wisconsin and building meaningful connections in communities that value health, affordability and friendly service."


**GRAND OPENING EVENTS – FREEBIES, DISCOUNTS AND SWEEPSTAKES**
Grand Opening festivities at the new Appleton, WI location include:


- **Sept. 30:** Mystery Gift Cards for the first 150 customers – Be among the first in line and receive a Natural Grocers mystery gift card (values range from $5 to $500).\[i\]
- **Sept. 30:** Free Natural Grocers Hand-Crafted Ecuadorian Drawstring Backpack Bag ($30 value) – The first 500 shoppers will receive a unique, hand-crafted bag, woven in collaboration with artisans in Peguche, Ecuador.\[ii\]
- **Sept. 30:** Prize Wheel – Spin the Natural Grocers prize wheel between 12 p.m. and 5 p.m. for a chance to win great prizes.\[iii\]
- **Sept. 30-Oct. 14:** Grand Opening Sweepstakes – Customers have the chance to win fabulous prizes, including an Aventon e-bike (valued at $1,400), a $500 Natural Grocers gift card and more. Entry forms will be available at the store.\[iv\]
- **Sept. 30-Oct. 31:** Up to 50% off Natural Grocers' Even More AffordableSM Prices on premium-quality products from every department, including 100% USDA-certified Organic Gala Apples ($1.69/lb), Natural Grocers® Brand Organic Cheese Shreds and Slices ($2.99 each), Bacon and Bacon Alternatives ($2.99/pkg, excludes Canadian Bacon), GT's Synergy® Kombucha ($2.79/16 oz) and Painterland Sisters Organic Skyr Yogurt ($1.99/each).\[v\]


**{N}POWER** **®** **MEMBERSHIP**
As part of Natural Grocers'["Even More AffordableSM Prices!"](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4774820-1&h=363750780&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Feven-more-affordable-prices&a=%22Even+More+AffordableSM%C2%A0Prices!%22) campaign, customers can[join {N}power](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4774820-1&h=4031482304&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Fnpower&a=join+%7BN%7Dpower) , the company's free rewards program, to access exclusive discounts, digital coupons, rewards benefits and other members-only features.*


- **Sept. 30-Oct. 31:** {N}power members will receive exclusive pricing on items such as select free-range eggs ($2.99 each, one dozen/limit 2), Kerrygold™ Irish Butter Sticks ($4.99/8 oz), Natural Grocers Brand Organic Canned Beans (4/$5, 15.5 oz, excludes green beans), Zevia® Zero-Sugar Sodas ($4.99/6 pack) and Natural Grocers Brand Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil ($8.99/16.9 oz).\[vi\]


**Customers can also*[download and sign into the free App](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4774820-1&h=1425562859&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Fnatural-grocers-app&a=download+and+sign+into+the+free+App) *to join the program.* *\[vii\]*


**STORE FEATURES AND THE NATURAL GROCERS EXPERIENCE** Serving communities with a wide range of natural and organic options since 1955, Natural Grocers will support Appleton and the surrounding communities with world-class customer service from its knowledgeable and dedicated good4u Crew,[healthy recipes for all diets](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4774820-1&h=2459452481&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Frecipe-finder&a=healthy+recipes+for+all+diets) and[high product standards](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4774820-1&h=1682216468&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Four-standards&a=high+product+standards) .


The company, ever conscious of its environmental impact, has upgraded the new space using sustainable building features and energy-saving innovations, such as non-toxic building materials and 100% LED lighting. The store will feature a contemporary layout for an efficient, yet friendly checkout experience.


**Customers can also expect:**


- **Environmentally Thoughtful Products and Practices:** From checkouts free from single-use bags, to organic, non-GMO and Always Affordable Natural Grocers brand products and ecologically thoughtful in-store features, the company focuses on a mutually beneficial relationship with nature.
- **Always Affordable Prices** : Access high-quality organic and natural groceries including 100% pasture-based dairy products and free-range eggs, 100% non-GMO prepackaged bulk goods, and household essentials at an Always Affordable Price. Natural Grocers also prioritizes humanely sourced and sustainably raised meats.
- **Always 100% Organic Produce:** Rest easy knowing Natural Grocers' organic produce is free from cross contamination with conventional/GMO items and grown without synthetic pesticides.
- **Body Care That Cares Back:** Natural Grocers' high standards prioritize natural, innovative and ethical body care products that deliver results without compromise.
- **A Super-Sized Supplement Department:** With over 6,000 products, Natural Grocers offers a large selection of vitamins and supplements, with the vast majority (over 80%) manufactured in third-party Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) certified facilities.
- **A Commitment to Crew:** Natural Grocers is passionate about ensuring that its employees can live a healthy, balanced life. The Company is committed to positively impacting Crew's physical, emotional and financial well-being with free nutrition education programs, excellent benefits and access to the highest quality, affordably priced products. To learn more about Natural Grocers' "Commitment to Crew" and its Five Founding Principles,[click here](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4774820-1&h=1708099359&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Four-five-founding-principles&a=click+here) .
- **Coming Soon: Nutritional Health Coaching:** Customers will have direct access to personalized assistance throughout their health journeys with an onsite Nutritional Health Coach.[Click here](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4774820-1&h=4161469721&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Fnutritional-health-coaches&a=Click+here) to learn more.


**FEEDING AMERICA EASTERN WISCONSIN AND NATURAL GROCERS**
As part of its commitment to the Appleton community, Natural Grocers will support[Feeding America Eastern Wisconsin](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4774820-1&h=196355145&u=https%3A%2F%2Ffeedingamericawi.org%2F&a=Feeding%C2%A0America+Eastern+Wisconsin) through its Bring Your Own Bag Program, donating five cents for every shopping trip in which customers use their own reusable bags. The program encourages sustainable shopping practices while also helping support the organization's mission to serving neighbors facing hunger across 35 counties.


Feeding America Eastern Wisconsin is the largest hunger relief organization in the state of Wisconsin, with food banks in Milwaukee and Appleton. In collaboration with nearly 600 pantry partners and trusted community-based programs, the organization provides nutritious, high-quality, and culturally relevant food to neighbors facing hunger across its expansive footprint.


"We're very grateful to Natural Grocers for their generosity and for being a committed partner in helping address food insecurity," said Feeding America Eastern Wisconsin President and CEO, Monique Kelley. "When businesses and communities come together to support their neighbors, we can reach more people with the food they need and help ensure no one has to face hunger alone."

**ABOUT NATURAL GROCERS BY VITAMIN COTTAGE** Founded in 1955, Natural Grocers by Vitamin Cottage, Inc. (NYSE: NGVC) is an expanding specialty retailer of natural and organic groceries, body care products and dietary supplements. The grocery products sold by Natural Grocers must meet strict quality guidelines and may not contain artificial flavors, preservatives or sweeteners (as defined by its standards), synthetic colors or partially hydrogenated or hydrogenated oils. The Company sells only USDA-certified organic produce and exclusively pasture-raised, non-confinement dairy products and free-range eggs. Natural Grocers' flexible smaller-store format allows it to offer affordable prices in a shopper-friendly, clean and convenient retail environment. The Company also provides extensive free science-based Nutrition Education programs to help customers and Crew make informed health and nutrition choices. Natural Grocers is committed to its[Five Founding Principles](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4774820-1&h=3172019908&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2Four-five-founding-principles&a=Five+Founding+Principles) —including its "Commitment to Community" and "Commitment to Crew." In fiscal year 2025, the Company invested more than $16 million in incremental compensation and discretionary payments for Crew. Headquartered in Lakewood, CO, Natural Grocers has 174 stores in 22 states. Visit[naturalgrocers.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4774820-1&h=2742613065&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.naturalgrocers.com%2F&a=naturalgrocers.com) for more information and store locations.
